title: A Friendly Email
text:
Hi Ali, thanks for your email. I am happy to hear from you! I am sorry for the late reply. I was busy with my exams.

Can we meet on Saturday? We can have lunch at my favourite cafe. Let me know what time is good for you. See you soon!

options: The writer was busy with exams

questions.text: Where do the writer and Ali want to have lunch?
options: At a big restaurant near the station

questions.text: How does the writer feel about the email from Ali?
Why does the writer ask Ali to let them know a good time?

vocabulary.definition: a message sent electronically from one person to another
having a lot of things to do

paragraph_translations: Merhaba Ali, e-postan için teşekkür ederim. Senden haber almak beni mutlu etti! Geç cevap verdiğim için özür dilerim. Sınavlarım yüzünden meşguldüm.
Cumartesi günü buluşabilir miyiz? Benim en sevdiğim kafede öğle yemeği yiyebiliriz. Bana hangi saatin uygun olduğunu bildir. Yakında görüşürüz!
